ToD_A02_M05_MESS_001.en: Build more Farms to continue unit production.,Build more Pigfarms to continue unit production.,Summon more Ziggurats to continue unit production.,Create more Moon Wells to continue unit production.
ToD_A02_M05_MESS_001.tr: 유닛을 계속 훈련하려면 농장을 추가로 건설해야 합니다.,유닛을 계속 생산하려면 돼지 농장을 추가로 건설해야 합니다.,유닛 생산을 계속하려면 지구라트를 더 소환해야 합니다.,유닛 훈련을 계속하려면 달샘을 추가로 건설해야 합니다.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_003.en:
|cff8080ffNEW HEROES|r
- Maim is a very powerful Melee warrior. Excellent for frontline assaults.
- Zuluhed is a strong caster. With great supporting spells.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_004.en:
|cff32cd32HINT|r
Zuluhed can use feral leap to teleport himself to the nearest region if he feels the spirits call.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_005.en:
|cff32cd32HINT|r
You can hire additional troops from the Blacktooth grin cave camp.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_006.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE ALTERATION|r
Troll Axe Throwers are not a part of your army in this mission. In their place you command the mighty orc Spearthrowers.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_007.en:
|cff32cd32HINT|r
Zuluhed can light the fire in the cave camp with his Lightning Strike.
Camp fire will help your units recover faster.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_008.en:
|cffffcc00SECRET FOUND|r
The mysterious dragon figurine was split into pieces and scattered across the land.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_009.en:
|cff87ceebREINFORCEMENT|r
These catapults will be very useful in the assault on Dun Modr.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_010.en:
|cff32cd32HINT|r
You can use Utok to scout dark areas.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_011.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
The industrial development of the Blackrock clan as well as access to huge metal deposits in the Searing Gorge, allowed the Horde to upgrade Great Halls to |cffffcc00Strongholds|r, that unlock new weapon and armor upgrades as well as new buildings to construct and units to produce.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_012.en:
|cff32cd32HINT|r
Utok now is under your control.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_013.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
You can now build catapults in the barracks.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_014.en:
|cff32cd32HINT|r
Zuluhed Stone Figurine can "heal" mechanical units, such as catapults.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_015.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Goblin Lab. This building allows player to build zeppelins and research upgrades for them.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_016.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE ALTERATION|r
Instead of the Troll lumber mill, you may construct orcish Warmills for your ranged units.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_017.en:
|cff87ceebREINFORCEMENT|r
You can use goblin zeppelin to scout the area.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_019.en:
|cff87ceebREINFORCEMENT|r
You can use now the Blacktooth grin Shipyard in the north of the map.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_022.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST FAILED|r
- Zuluhed has been slain

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_023.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST FAILED|r
- Maim has been slain

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_027.en:
|cff87ceebREINFORCEMENT|r
Captured cannons are priceless! Use them wisely and try not to lose them.

ToD_A02_M05_MESS_028.en: Powerful far-range cannon, but slow and voulnerable.|n|n|cffffcc00Attacks ground targets (Including trees).|r

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_002.en: Troubles have arisen in the Dwarven lands of Khaz Modan. A taskforce of Stromgarde warriors have laid siege to Dun Modr - a vital staging area for Horde troops. You are to retake Dun Modr.

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_003.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST|r
Retake Dun Modr
  - Capture the Northern Citadel
  - Capture the Southern Citadel
  - Zuluhed must survive
  - Maim must survive

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_008.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST UPDATE|r
Retake Dun Modr
  -|cff808080 Capture the Northern Citadel (Completed)|r
  - Capture the Southern Citadel
  - Zuluhed must survive
  - Maim must survive

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_011.en: In order to perform a successful assault on Tol Barad, you will need a strong fleet and Improved weapons for your forces. Establish a stronghold, build your fleet and prepare your warriors for the task at hand.

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_012.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST|r
Fortify Dun Modr
  - Upgrade to a Stronghold
  - Build a Shipyard
  - Build a Foundry
  - Build a Refinery

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_028.en:
|cffffcc00OPTIONAL QUEST|r
Dwarven Partisans
  - Destroy the Dwarven Resistance

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_030.en: The dwarves of Dun Modr were thought defeated after the first Horde assault on this region, but a band of the bearded vermin have begun to attack our positions in force.. find their camp and destroy them.

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_033.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST|r
Destroy Tol Barad
  - Destroy the Keep
  - Kill the Duke

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_034.en: Tol Barad is an important strategic base that guarantees the safety of Stromgarde itself. Bring your forces to bear against Tol Barad and bring it to its knees.

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_037.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST UPDATE|r
Destroy Tol Barad
  -|cff808080 Destroy the Keep (Completed)|r
  - Kill the Duke

ToD_A02_M05_OBJ_038.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST UPDATE|r
Destroy Tol Barad
  - Destroy the Keep
  -|cff808080 Kill the Duke (Completed)|r
